copy.curiosityHook: Confronted with the vibrant ache of mortal love, can an invisible observer truly surrender eternity to become human?
copy.description: In Wim Wenders's romantic fantasy, two angels silently roam Berlin to comfort troubled mortals. When Damiel falls for a lonely trapeze artist, he yearns to give up immortality to walk the physical world.
copy.vibeSummary: A slow, contemplative fantasy romance offering gentle emotional resonance and rich, observant beauty.
copy.whyWatch: Wenders crafts a slow, lyrical meditation on human longing, transforming city streets into a thoughtful romantic drama illuminated by an angel's sudden wish for mortal touch.

allowedMaterial: Damiel and Cassiel observing Berlin's citizens
Damiel falling in love with trapeze artist Marion
Damiel longing to experience mortal, physical life
Peter Falk offering wisdom regarding taking human form
excludedMaterial: The ultimate romantic outcome between Damiel and Marion
